issues.where: Number '52' and its yellow pulse copy
issues.change: The number was shifted up by 0.72 after the pulse copy was made, so the glow was drawn at a different spot than the number and the number ended up crowded under the title. I removed that shift so the number stays at UP*1.5 and the pulse lines up exactly on it.

issues.where: number_line: unit_size=0.8 makes the line 80 units long, and the extra shift of 33.08 to the right pushes it further out of frame
issues.change: Set unit_size to 0.12 so the line is 12 units long. Removed the stray shift and centred the line at DOWN*0.5.

issues.where: num_label / zero_label text was drawn directly over the number line's own tick numbers (the doubled '10' and '0')
issues.change: Placed zero_label and each num_label above the line (next_to UP) so they no longer cover the built-in tick numbers.
Moved zero_label above the line with buff=0.45 so it clears the cross.

issues.where: not_dapple_text centred under 0 ran past the left edge
issues.change: Aligned its left edge with the cross (aligned_edge=LEFT) and put it below the tick numbers.

issues.where: Neighbouring 'Dapple' labels were only 1.2 units apart
issues.change: Put the dapple_text labels above the number labels at font_size 20 so neighbours keep clear gaps.

issues.where: final cleanup faded out title and number_line twice
issues.change: Fade out each mobject only once.

issues.where: dapple_52 transformed into digit5 and then digit2, all at ORIGIN
issues.change: Moved the original 52 up to UP*1.5 and placed digit5 and digit2 side by side at DOWN*0.8 (LEFT/RIGHT 0.6). Each digit now appears with TransformFromCopy from 52, so the digits no longer stack on each other or on 52.

issues.where: red 2/5 transforms and the swapped 25 drawn on top of the leftover dapple_52 at the origin
issues.change: The red digits are now placed at the digit positions and 25 is centred on the digit pair, away from 52.

issues.where: arrow and 'Reversal' text next_to dapple_52 collided with the digits and label
issues.change: The arrow now sits to the right of the digit pair with 'Reversal' above it.
dapple_label now fades out during the reversal step and is dropped from the final FadeOut.
